lessons.reason: pull request creation was attempted before the intended remote head ref was verified to exist at the expected SHA
lessons.rootCause: the mutation sequence assumed branch/ref availability instead of reading the exact remote head identity before creating the PR
lessons.fix: verify the remote head branch/ref exists and matches the intended exact SHA before create_pull_request; fail closed on missing or mismatched head

lessons.reason: repository code discovery used a tool whose contract was not code search, producing incomplete or misleading capability results
lessons.rootCause: the connector action was selected by intuition rather than by the action schema that explicitly supports repository code search
lessons.fix: use GitHub.search for code discovery and use fetch_file only when an exact path is already known

lessons.reason: a draft pull request ready transition was attempted through generic PR mutation instead of the dedicated ready-for-review action
lessons.rootCause: draft lifecycle semantics were conflated with ordinary pull request metadata updates
lessons.fix: use mark_pull_request_ready_for_review for the semantic transition; if the known connector GraphQL schema failure occurs, apply RECREATE_READY_PR_ON_CONNECTOR_GRAPHQL_FAILURE on the identical tested head SHA
